entries.name: cylon-desktop.htm
entries.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Cylon Desktop Environment</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; background-color: #000; color: #0f0; overflow: hidden; }
        /* Include necessary GFX CSS here */
    </style>
    <!-- Include the graphics engine -->
    <script src="qandy-sound.js"></script>
    <script src="gfx.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- The graphics engine will inject its DOM elements here -->

<script>
    // 1. Configure the GFX Engine for the Desktop
    window.gfxDrive = 'cylon.gfx'; // The virtual drive holding your desktop map
    
    // 2. Client Hooks required by gfx.js
    
    // Called when the user clicks a static object (like a desk, computer, etc.)
    window.objdown = function(code) {
        // code = itemID + z-location (e.g., 'Yj44')
        let itemId = code.substring(0, 2);
        
        switch(itemId) {
            case 'Ta': // Let's pretend 'Ta' is an Arcade Cabinet graphic
                // Tell the outer Qandy Pocket Computer shell to launch Lunar Lander
                if (window.parent && window.parent.loadUrl) {
                    window.parent.loadUrl('lunar.htm');
                }
                break;
            case 'Tb': // Let's pretend 'Tb' is a Calculator on a desk
                if (window.parent && window.parent.loadUrl) {
                    window.parent.loadUrl('calc.htm');
                }
                break;
            // Add more objects here!
        }
    };

    window.itemdown = function(code) {
        // Handle dynamic item clicks (picking up files/apps)
        window.gfxClick("ID" + code); 
    };

    window.serverdown = function(code) {
        // Handle custom punch-code server responses (UNIVAC plugins)
        console.log("UNIVAC sent to desktop:", code);
    };

    // 3. Boot the connection
    window.onload = async function() {
        // Set map dimensions to fit nicely inside the pocket computer screen
        window.mapx = 7;
        window.mapy = 11;
        
        // Connect to the Qandyland Server
        await gfxConnect(1); 
    };
</script>
</body>
</html>
